full_judgment:
Mr. Syed Mahmud Hossain, J:- This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 23.03.2011 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.4365 of 2004 discharging the Rule and affirming the judgment and decree dated 17.07.2004 passed by the learned Judge, Paribesh Appeal Court, Dhaka in Title Appeal No.106 of 1995 allowing the appeal and setting aside the Judgment and decree dated 26. 02. 1995 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Keranigonj, Dhaka in Title Suit No.103 of 1993 decreeing the suit on contest against defendant No.1 and an ex parte against the remaining defendants without any order as to costs. 

 The petitioner as the plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.103 of 1993 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Keranigonj, Dhaka for permanent injunction: against the defendant-respondents. His case, in short, is, that the suit land originally belonged to Jabbar Matbar, who died leaving behind only son Nawab Ali and S. A. khatian was recorded in his name. After that, Nawab Ali sold 39 decimals of land appertaining to C. S. khatian No-15 and S. A. Plot No.194 to Gulrehan Bibi by a registered deed of sale dated 12.07.1974 and Gulrehan Bibi sold out the suit land by a No.1) by a registered deed of sale dated registered deed of sale dated 23.09.1982. Fazio! Haque mutated his 08.12.1989 to the plaintiff and handed name on 09.09.1987 by filing Mutation over possession to him. Accordingly, Case No.46 of 1987-88 and has been the plaintiff had been paying rents and possessing the suit land by paying rents possessing the suit land by cultivating Nawab Miah could not sell the suit land the same and the defendants have no right, title and possession in the suit land. Thereafter, on 22.10.1993, the defendants forcibly tried to enter into the suit land but failed and started threatening the plaintiff to dispossess from the suit land. Therefore, the plaintiff compelled to file the suit for permanent injunction. 

 3. The defendants contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the material statements made in the plaint. Their case, in short, is that the suit land originally belonged to Nawab Miah, who sold the same on 07.09.1972 to Sawdagar Miah, father-in--law of Nawab Miah's daughter, Momtaz Begum and handed over .possession to him on verbal condition that if Nawab Miah could return the consideration money. Sawdagar Miah would register a deed in favour of Nawab Miah's daughter, that is, Sawdagar Miah's daughter-in-law, Momtaz Begum. In the meantime, Sawdagar Miah died, Subsequently, sons of Sawdagar Miah (defendant Nos.l-4) and defendant Nos.5- 10. grandsons of Sawdagar Miah, transferred the same by a registered deed of sale dated 30,04.1977 in favour of Momtaz Begum. Momtaz Begum had been possessing the suit and through her husband. Kalai Miah and got her name recorded in R.S. record. After that, Momtaz Begum sold the suit land to her brother-in-law, Fazlul Haque (defendant to Gulrehan Bibi as at that time he was not owner of the suit land. Nawab Miah's son —Jamaiuddin created false deed dated 12.07.1974 in the name of his mother-in-law, Gulrehan Bibi and published the same in 1989 and the plaintiff did not disclose it during the life time of Nawab Miah. Defendant No.1, Fazlul Haque mutated his name on 09.09.1987 and after one month, the' plaintiff very secretly mutated his name, who has no right title and possession over the suit land and as such, the suit is liable to be dismissed. 

 5. Against the judgment and decree of the trial Court, the defendants preferred Title Appeal No.106 of 1995 before the learned District Judge, Dhaka. Subsequently, the appeal was transferred to the Court of Paribesh Appeal Court for hearing and the learned Judge of the Paribesh Appeal Court, Dhaka after hearing the parties by her judgment and order dated 17.07.2004 allowed the appeal and set aside the judgment and decree of the trial Court. 

 12. Admittedly, the suit land belonged to Nawab Ali who that Nawab Ali sold the suit land to Sawdagor Mia by a registered deed of sale dated 07.09.1972. Sawdagor Mia again sold the suit land to Gulrehan Bibi by a registered deed of sale dated 12.07.1979 who sold the suit land. to the plaintiff by a registered deed of sale dated 08.12.1989. Admittedly, Nawab Ali extinguished his interest in the suit land on 07.09.1972 by executing and registering a deed of sale in favour of Sawdagor Mia. Therefore Gulrehan Bibi did not derives any interest in the suit land by the registered deed of sale dated 12.07.1974 and consequently, the plaintiff also could not prove his prima facie title in the disputed land by his alleged purchase dated 08.12.1979 from Gulrehan Bibi.
